status: Reusable production learned-router Trellis FFN request executor qualified; full-model admission and vLLM parity remain open; whole goal active

implementation.module: src/transformer/trellis.c within the existing transformer module, following the resident BF16 profile split
implementation.api_header: include/transformer_internal.h; internal component API, not ordinary generation admission
implementation.ownership: One request container owned by the existing BnBackendSession. Request-local metadata/index/activation/fused/folded/shared buffers and backend workspace are allocated during setup, then reused across calls and shape changes. Cleanup uses its own request/destroy hook and never dereferences model/weight storage.
schedule: Learned native router and assignment index
CPU planning from one counts read, preserving upstream expert/group order, exact padded rows and the source 256 MiB TWO-slab batch heuristic
All three fused row tiers, retaining FULL-tier group widths across residency windows
Source-shaped grouped gather and folded FFN using one decoded slab sequentially
One fixed-top-k reduction, native shared F16 FFN and final device F32 addition
implementation.placement: Existing expert-bridge statistics/leases/admission only; the executor never accesses cache internals. Prefill borrows cache hits and uses separately budgeted temporaries on misses, while decode admits/promotes. Fully cached experts require no temporary pool.
implementation.failure: Structural/input/model/budget rejection preserves output arguments. BUSY and failed batches complete outstanding consumers before releasing partly acquired leases. Reported stream-completion failure destroys/drains the private request before releasing weights, leaving reset/setup required. Previous result views expire at the next attempt.
implementation.boundaries: An F16 scalar role was added to the existing backend scalar abstraction. The bridge and top-level GPU sequencer are byte-identical to the prior stage; the boundary guard was not modified; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md describe the transformer subfile ownership. No model-family predicates or CPU activation fallback were introduced.

budgets.scope: Device quota is a conservative bound on explicit activation and backend-workspace payloads, counting shared backend workspace independently. Host quota covers executor-owned heap payload. Shared weights/expert caches, BnSession host logits/history, backend request metadata, caller stack, library/driver and allocator overhead are separate; this is not whole-process RSS/VRAM admission.
budgets.cold_expert_store: Five entries each in RAM, decode and temporary pools; entry13315584 bytes, each pool66577920 bytes, host staging13315584 bytes. The one-expert fused window does not shrink heavy groups.
budgets.resident_expert_store: All384 layer39 expert triples cached in decode placement; temporary pool disabled. Execution reads/uploads zero expert bytes. This is a resident layer, not the full large model.

validation.reuse: Forward and reverse shape order on the same two policy-specific requests; zero execution activation allocations and zero execution request creations in every run.
validation.synthetic: Recording backend exercises query/output rejection, scalar roles, insufficient budgets, every activation-allocation rollback point, idempotence, incompatible setup, model identity, reset/free and rejection before GPU work when router weights are missing.
validation.real_failures: Real CUDA setup allocation fault, pending-key BUSY after partial acquisition, and an injected completion failure with asynchronous work queued. Weight destruction is checked to occur after request drain; every request is destroyed exactly once and all leases are released.
validation.warning_note: Normal/probe builds are warning-free. The whole-module Clang ASAN unit build retains the three source-hash-verified pre-existing unused helpers in unchanged moe_cpu_kernels.c, without suppression.

profile.scope: One warmed R8192, layer39, FP16-partial-policy1, fully cached 384-expert layer with zero temporary pool and fused window32. Input writes, cache/model/request setup and reference comparisons are outside capture. This is not full-model or vLLM throughput.

profile.limitation: 17 lease-boundary waits plus counts, metadata write and final completion waits remain; a resident lease-borrowing fast path can remove per-window/group fences without changing source geometry.

remaining: The API explicitly selects learned routing and supports the general prefill profile, tokens>8. V4.1 defaults to zero hash-routing layers, so every layer uses learned routing. Specialized <=8 BC decode was outside this prefill qualification.
Full attention, compressed/indexed/shared KV, Engram, full forward/generation/CLI and end-to-end short/long/chunked/resumed correctness remain required for this native model path.

The executor currently waits at each lease boundary and performs host counts planning. The warm trace measures21 synchronizations and3 metadata transfers; resident lease retention and asynchronous placement are future performance work.

No active-call cancellation or concurrent store mutation is supported; caller serializes access. Continuous batching, chunked serving/KV admission, tail latency and full resource accounting remain open.
This reference qualification is not matched vLLM performance parity. Original packaged-library and paired-system-library references remain preserved independently.
